description: Implementation of UDP network gateway including socket creation, binding, receiving, and sending logic, with detailed socket options and error handling.

classes.name: receive_context
classes.description: Context structure used for receiving UDP packets via recvmmsg, managing buffers and message headers.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::subscribe_to
methods.description: Registers the UDP socket with an IO broker for asynchronous receive operations.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles outgoing PDU by batching and preparing for transmission.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Processes batched PDUs, constructs message headers, and sends via sendmmsg.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::receive
methods.description: Receives incoming UDP packets using recvmmsg and forwards them to the data notifier.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::create_and_bind
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to specified address and port, with options for interface binding and non-blocking mode.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_sockopts
methods.description: Sets socket options such as receive timeout and DSCP.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_non_blocking
methods.description: Configures the socket to operate in non-blocking mode.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_receive_timeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for socket receive operations.

methods.name: udp_network_gateway_impl::set_dscp
methods.description: Sets DSCP value on the socket for QoS.
